source.collect_mysql.py: Symbolia read-only MySQL collector, first generation (my1): fixed SELECT/SHOW reads through the mysql client, password by MYSQL_PWD only, never authentication_string; the observable sections of symbolia.mysql-declared-input.v0 merged with the customer declaration file; the frozen sensitive-field filter (rev 20) run over the whole document before any byte is written
